issues.description: Independent test verification shows tests_passed: false, contradicting Player's claim of tests_passed: true. However, the independent test raw_output shows only 'I'll run the test command for you.' with no actual pytest results, suggesting the test capture failed. Runtime parity shows exit_code: 0 (passed), creating conflicting signals.
issues.suggestion: Re-run independent test verification to obtain actual pytest output. The test command was 'pytest tests/forge/memory/test_scrub_process_output.py -v --tb=short' which should produce detailed pytest output, not just a message. Verify whether tests actually failed or if this is a data collection issue.

criteria_verification.notes: Function signature and export verified via requirements evidence: implemented at lines 158-210 with proper type hints, exported in __all__ at line 213

Purity verified via requirements evidence: stdlib-only, no I/O or logging, TypeError for non-str input, 5 test cases including log capture verification

Lint/format checks verified via requirements evidence: ruff check and ruff format --check passed with zero errors

rationale: All acceptance criteria are individually verified in the requirements evidence bundle. However, there is a critical conflict in test signals: independent_tests.tests_passed is false while runtime_parity passed (exit 0) and Player claims tests passed. The independent test raw_output contains only 'I'll run the test command for you.' instead of actual pytest results, suggesting a data collection failure. Per instructions to treat independent_tests as authoritative, this ambiguous negative signal must be resolved before approval, despite all other evidence supporting success.
